answer: Pay only net value crossing a cluster's boundary. Emission routes along edges where the receiver signs it used the output, so value a cluster sends itself cancels out. Cluster membership is read from the public funding graph each close; the garden of outside demand is the only positive net flow. To earn, an operator must deliver output outside parties choose to consume, unfakeable by cloning. Reward tracks the river of value leaving to real users, not keys.
